title: The Pair Annihilation
description:
Grid-based and turn-based roguelike[/h2]After defeat in the war against the Udtmos, we were forced to flee the stellar system.
We must rewind everything with only three pilots.

Create the ultimate shipVarious Reactor Cores - You will obtain a Reactor Core at the end of each battle that you can mount on your ship. And its effect will stack with each other.

Various ships and weapons - All ships have two weapons with different effects. And you can craft and equip a sub weapon.

Reach the star through the best pathVarious missions - On the battlefield, you'll encounter various missions, such as destroying incubators or blocking portals. And maybe even some random events in the Dark Zone.

Various bosses - The higher Udtmos that defend the planet each have special abilities. Unpredictable boss battles will require your best strategic choices.

There's moreTurn Rewind - Once per battle, you can return all ally ships to the state at the beginning of the turn. You can fire ships' weapons or move ships 2 times.

Carrier - The carrier has no combat abilities, but due to its Temporal Rewinder, you must defend it and fight no matter what.

Various Carrier Skills and Enhancers - You can also craft Carrier Skills and Enhancers that can be useful in battle. Rescuing and placing survivors can also unlock additional abilities.

We're looking forward to your victory.
description_short: 'The Pair Annihilation' is grid + turn-based strategy roguelike game. Use different combinations of ships, different artifacts, in battles on various battlefields to defeat Udtmos!
